$schema: Energy Ring catalog. May be enriched by scripts/sync-parts.mjs.

rings.name: Pegasus I
rings.info: Original Pegasus ring with five-wing motif. Right-spin balanced. Used by Storm and Cyber Pegasus.

rings.name: Pegasus II
rings.info: Refined Pegasus ring used in Galaxy Pegasus. Tighter wing design.

rings.name: Pegasus III
rings.info: 4D-era Pegasus ring for Big Bang Pegasis. Largest, most aggressive of the series.

rings.name: L-Drago I
rings.info: Original left-spin dragon ring. Used in Lightning L-Drago.

rings.name: L-Drago II
rings.info: Refined left-spin dragon ring with more defensive scaling. Used in Meteo L-Drago.

rings.name: Leone I
rings.info: Original lion ring with crested mane shape. Used in Rock and Counter Leone.

rings.name: Leone II
rings.info: Refined lion ring with sharper mane edges. Used in Fang Leone.

rings.name: Sagittario
rings.info: Centaur archer ring. Stamina-leaning shape. Used in Flame Sagittario.

rings.name: Eagle
rings.info: Spread-wing ring. Balance-type shape. Used in Earth Eagle.

rings.name: Bull
rings.info: Horned ring with aggressive defense profile. Used in Dark Bull.

rings.name: Fireblaze
rings.info: Phoenix-flame ring. Stamina shape. Used in Burn Fireblaze.

rings.name: Aries
rings.info: Ram ring with defensive horn pattern. Used in Rock Aries.

rings.name: Virgo
rings.info: Maiden ring with stamina-balance shape. Used in Earth Virgo.

rings.name: Aquario
rings.info: Wave ring with defense profile. Used in Storm Aquario.

rings.name: Kerbecs
rings.info: Three-headed dog ring with heavy defense profile. Used in Hades (Hell) Kerbecs.

rings.name: Striker I
rings.info: Bird-of-prey ring with attack profile. Used in Ray Striker.

rings.name: Horuseus
rings.info: Egyptian-falcon ring with defense profile. Used in Vulcan Horuseus.

rings.name: Destroyer
rings.info: Greek-warrior ring with defense-stamina profile. Used in Gravity Perseus (international name: Destroyer).

rings.name: Serpent
rings.info: Coiled snake ring with stamina-trick shape. Used in Poison Serpent.

rings.name: Orion
rings.info: Constellation hunter ring with stamina shape. Used in Phantom Orion.

rings.name: Nemesis A
rings.info: Final-villain ring designed for bidirectional spin. Used in Diablo Nemesis.

rings.name: Ares
rings.info: War-god ring with mode-change geometry. Used in Variares.
